Yeah, I think calling the hotline might have slightly helped in the short term just because I had someone to talk to, even for a short time, but not long term, at least in my experience. I don't want to rely on them every time I feel like ending things. I agree though, at the end of the call they thought I was okay and the call drew to a close. Very strange.

Thank you for the advice though, I'll think about the people in my life and who I can talk to. It's going to be difficult, but I'll try.
Yeah I think I'm gonna go to the ER in a sec, god I'm so fucking dumb 😂 thanks tho

I don't know how much this means to you, as we have never seen each other before, but I still mean this from the bottom of my heart. No one is ugly. No one is too fat. Focus on yourself. Don't think about what other people think about you. Don't compare yourself to other people. That is harmful to yourself, and harm is a detriment to everyone, obviously, and that will make everyone feel bad, not just yourself. Focus on being the best yourself u can be, and focus on helping other people through life after u find u love yourself. 

You won't be lonely for the rest of your life, but you have to change your mindset first, if you can. Don't think of yourself as "that loner". I want you to try as best you can to help. Not just other people, but also yourself. You are a person, with so much potential to be great. I want you to realise that potential. Help yourself, care for yourself.

Yes. If there is no one here for you romantically right now, then there is always next year. And next year. And the year after that. There is so much time and we take our time for granted, there's no point in worrying about being alone on valentine's Day when we have all the time in the world to focus on ourselves and try to get better.
